about.intro_text: Welcome to :name. We are Habiganj's #1 Walton authorized electronics showroom, committed to bringing genuine products with manufacturer warranty right to your doorstep.
about.intro_paragraph: Since our founding, we've served thousands of happy customers with top-quality electronics, transparent pricing, and dedicated after-sales support. Our mission is to make quality electronics accessible to everyone in the region.
about.mission_text: To provide genuine, high-quality electronics at fair prices with exceptional customer service. We aim to be the most trusted electronics destination in Bangladesh, ensuring every customer gets the best value, expert guidance, and reliable after-sales support.
about.vision_text: To become Bangladesh's leading electronics retail chain, recognized for innovation, trust, and customer satisfaction. We envision a future where every household has access to modern technology through our expanding network of showrooms and online presence.
about.walton_dealer_desc: We are an officially authorized dealer for Walton products, ensuring you receive genuine items with full manufacturer warranty coverage.
about.local_showroom_desc: Visit our showroom to experience products hands-on. Our expert staff helps you choose the right electronics for your needs and budget.
about.after_sales_support_desc: Our relationship doesn't end at the sale. We provide dedicated after-sales service, warranty claims, and technical support whenever you need it.
about.customer_first_desc: Every decision we make is driven by what's best for our customers. From product selection to delivery, your satisfaction is our top priority.
about.trusted_desc: We believe in building long-term relationships with our customers through honesty, quality, and exceptional service.
contact.intro_text: We're here to help — reach out for support, partnership, or vendor onboarding. Our team responds within 24 hours.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro_text: Find answers to the most common questions about shopping, delivery, payments, and returns.
faq.ordering_q1: How do I place an order?
faq.ordering_a1: Browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Fill in your delivery details and select Cash on Delivery as your payment method. Click "Place Order" and we'll contact you to confirm.
faq.ordering_q2: Can I modify my order after placing it?
faq.ordering_a2: Please contact us immediately if you need to modify your order. Changes can only be made before the order is dispatched.
faq.ordering_q3: Do I need an account to order?
faq.ordering_a3: No, you can place orders as a guest. However, creating an account allows you to track orders and save your details for faster checkout.
faq.delivery_a1: Standard delivery within Dhaka takes 1-2 business days. Outside Dhaka, delivery takes 3-5 business days. You'll receive a confirmation call before dispatch.
faq.delivery_a2: Delivery inside Dhaka is ৳60. Delivery outside Dhaka is ৳120. Free delivery on orders over ৳2,000.
faq.delivery_a3: Yes, once your order is dispatched, you'll receive tracking information via SMS. You can also contact our support team for updates.
faq.payment_q1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.payment_a1: We currently offer Cash on Delivery (COD) for all orders. bKash and Nagad payment options will be available soon.
faq.payment_q2: Is it safe to pay Cash on Delivery?
faq.payment_a2: Yes, COD is completely safe. You pay only when you receive and verify your products. No advance payment required.
faq.returns_a1: We offer a 7-day return policy for most products. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Contact us to initiate a return.
faq.returns_q2: How do I get a refund?
faq.returns_a2: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days to your original payment method.
